entities.name: Kinesis Data Streams (Collect)
entities.rationale: Top-left Kinesis stream used to collect cloud provider security events.

entities.name: Amazon Neptune
entities.rationale: Primary graph database in the center of the diagram, storing resource state.

entities.name: Elasticsearch
entities.rationale: Elasticsearch service used for reporting, analytics, and search capabilities.

entities.name: Amazon DynamoDB
entities.rationale: DynamoDB used for storage of resource configurations and security violations.

entities.name: Kinesis Data Streams (Rules)
entities.rationale: Bottom-left Kinesis stream used to queue events for rule execution.

entities.name: Amazon CloudWatch
entities.rationale: CloudWatch on the right, providing metrics used by the sharder.

entities.name: Sharder Service
entities.rationale: Custom shard service labeled 'SHARD' that groups data and evaluates cluster capacities.

entities.name: Slack
entities.rationale: Slack icon in the bottom right corner for real-time notifications.

entities.name: Email
entities.rationale: Email icon in the bottom right corner for real-time notifications.

visual_connections.description: Data flows from Collect Kinesis Data Streams to Amazon Neptune with '50M+' annotation.
Collect Kinesis Data Streams triggers/passes events to Rules Kinesis Data Streams.
Data is synchronized/sent from Neptune to Elasticsearch.
Data is synchronized/sent from Neptune to DynamoDB.
Metrics or data flows from Neptune to CloudWatch.
Metrics flow from Elasticsearch to CloudWatch.
CloudWatch metrics are consumed by the Sharder Service.
Feedback/control loop from Sharder Service back to Neptune.
Neptune feeds data into Rules Kinesis Data Streams for policy evaluation.
Rules Kinesis queries Neptune to perform security checks.
Rules Kinesis queries/stores configurations in DynamoDB.
